hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a 0.7% fee on every swap: ETH input from buys accumulates in a burn pot for periodic buyback-and-burn operations triggered every 20 swaps, and token input from sells is burned directly. Liquidity addition is one-time only per token, and sells are blocked in the same block as a buyback execution.
